costs.body: A BMW Z4 sDrive23i or sDrive28i engine rebuild starts from £3,200. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
